About the Christmas pick images

All nine picks use genuine historic photographs or film frames related to their themes, not photographs of the advertised events or venues. Images are presented without artificial ageing or recolouring, with the full image fitted into the frame. Source and licence details:

  • The Clash in concert, Oslo, 1980Helge Øverås · CC BY-SA 4.0 · Archive photograph of The Clash, not Dislocation Dance or the advertised performers. Unmodified photograph.
  • Christmas music party, London, 1944Ministry of Information Photo Division / Imperial War Museums, D 23289 · Public domain (expired Crown copyright) · Historical Christmas concert, not the advertised gig or its performers. Commons identifies the original Crown copyright as expired; use the Commons scan, not a separate IWM download.
  • Christmas crafts, Cambridgeshire, 1944Ministry of Information Photo Division / Imperial War Museums, D 23619 · Public domain (expired Crown copyright) · Historic paper crafts, not the current adult workshop. Commons record identifies the Crown copyright as expired; use the Commons scan, not an IWM download under separate terms.
  • Willow craft, Yorkshire, c.1900–12Sydney Harold Smith or collaborators / York Museums Trust, YORYM S48 · Public domain · Historic willow preparation for baskets, not willow stars or the current workshop.
  • Christmas market, Munich, 1975Bundesarchiv, B 145 Bild-F047438-0005 / Storz · CC BY-SA 3.0 DE · Historic German market, not Station South. Source version was cropped by the Commons contributor in 2021; no further image editing.
  • Little Tich, music hall, 1900Clément Maurice · Public domain · A genuine historic film frame, not Frankie Monroe.
  • Christmas cabaret, Stockholm, 1974LJP assistant / Lars Jacob Prod archive / Southerly Clubs · Public domain (rights-holder release) · Historic cabaret, not the current cast. Commons VRT ticket 2010092510008875 confirms the release; source flags the image as blurry.
  • Cinema auditorium, 2018Jorge Simonet · CC BY-SA 4.0 · Photograph taken in 2018 of a cinema auditorium, not a CULTPLEX photograph, a still from the advertised film or an image from 1985.
  • David Bowie, TopPop, 1974AVRO / Netherlands Institute for Sound and Vision · CC BY-SA 3.0 · Archive photograph of Bowie, not the quartet.
